# Quillcode

Quillcode pairs light and dark palettes that its description ties to sunlit desks and lamplit writing nooks, aimed at a writer-focused workspace. Ink-like accents and aged-paper textures are used to separate code from prose, and the interface is kept minimal while still offering visual contrast where it is wanted.

![Quillcode screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theaayushpatel/quillcode/HEAD/assets/dark-screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Quillcode"
    author: "theaayushpatel"
    repo:   "theaayushpatel/quillcode"
    slug:   "quillcode"

    github_url:     "https://github.com/theaayushpatel/quillcode"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theaayushpatel/quillcode/HEAD/assets/dark-screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Create a serene, writer-focused workspace with paired light and dark palettes that evoke sunlit desks and lamplit writing nooks. Display subtle ink-like accents and aged-paper textures to emphasize clarity between code and prose. Keep the interface minimal and discreet while offering notable visual contrast when needed."
}
```
